+		Expect(loaded.LastVisitedAt).To(Equal(gg.P(visitedAt)))
+	})
+})

 // Package gg implements simple "extensions" to Go language. Based on https://github.com/icza/gog
 package gg
 
+// P returns a pointer to v, including when v is the zero value of T.
+func P[T any](v T) *T {
+	return &v
+}
+
+// V returns the value pointed to by p, or the zero value of T if p is nil.
+func V[T any](p *T) T {
+	if p == nil {
+		var zero T
+		return zero
+	}
+	return *p
+}
+
 // If returns v if it is a non-zero value, orElse otherwise.
 //
 // This is similar to elvis operator (?:) in Groovy and other languages.
